meta.name: RF Catacombs
meta.description: Free dungeon/catacombs tileset pack (RF_Catacombs_v1.0.zip), unzipped from the repo root. Not wired into any game yet. PSD source files from the original zip were dropped when extracting (design sources, not needed for a Phaser build); the full originals remain recoverable from git history on the commit that added this pack.

atlases.note: Mixed-size wall/floor/door/torch-holder tiles packed into one sheet, not a uniform grid. Individual regions need to be sliced by hand or with a texture-packer atlas (Phaser texture.add.rect / TexturePacker JSON), not a fixed frameWidth/frameHeight.
Mixed-size decorative props (banners, statues, rocks, crates) packed into one sheet, not a uniform grid.

animationFrameSets.description: Candle A flicker animation, one file per frame (dimensions vary slightly frame to frame - normal for hand-trimmed pixel animation).
Candle B flicker animation, one file per frame.
Floor spike trap animation (extend/retract), one file per frame.
Wall torch flame animation, one file per frame.

usage: For the atlases: load with this.load.image(key, basePath + path) and either slice manually with frame rects or repack with a texture-packer tool - there is no fixed frameWidth/frameHeight. For the animationFrameSets: load each frame file as a separate image (this.load.image), then this.anims.create({ key, frames: frames.map(f => ({ key: f.textureKey })), frameRate, repeat }) since these are discrete files rather than one spritesheet.
